prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [验证] 二维合并 · 采购评审 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 4 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "甲、乙两家报价接近，建议进入第二轮商务谈判，重点" spans 1 col × 2 row; "未按要求提交完整报价文件，视为无效投标" spans 3 col × 1 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "供应商" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 2: header "报价" · longest unbreakable word 65px · one-line width 65px
  col 3: header "交期" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 38px
  col 4: header "质保" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 5: header "评审意见" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 582px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"比较供应商报价、交期和质保，并记录评审意见及无效投标结果。","reading":"读者先按行识别供应商，再横向比较报价、交期和质保；甲、乙共享的评审意见跨两行，丙的无效投标说明横跨三个指标列。","groups":["报价、交期、质保是并列的采购比较指标，应保持清晰的列间节奏。","供应商是行标识；评审意见是解释性文字，与数值指标的阅读方式不同。"],"keep_intact":["报价金额及货币符号，便于准确比较。","供应商名称、交期和质保值尽量保持完整，便于按行扫描。","跨行评审意见和跨列无效投标说明的合并关系。"],"may_wrap":["评审意见可按中文自然换行；其跨两行的高度可吸收部分换行。","无效投标说明可在横跨报价、交期和质保的单元格内自然换行。","空间紧张时，中文表头和供应商名称可以换行，但会降低扫描速度。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [60, 86, 59, 52, 102] · table 360×319px · row heights [60, 100, 100, 60] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 8 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [60, 86, 59, 52, 102] · table 360×319px · row heights [60, 100, 100, 60] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 8 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [60, 86, 52, 52, 109] · table 360×319px · row heights [60, 100, 100, 60] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 8 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"报价、交期和质保值均保持完整，三个采购指标便于横向比较；跨两行的评审意见和跨三列的无效投标说明也容易辨认。","problems":"供应商表头及各供应商名称都被拆成两行，削弱了行标识的扫描速度；评审意见较窄，形成密集的多行文字。","cause":"供应商列宽60px，扣除21px后只有39px文字空间，小于单行所需的46px；评审意见列宽102px，文字空间为81px。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"与r2A相同：报价、交期和质保值完整，合并单元格的关系清楚。","problems":"与r2A相同：供应商表头和名称换行，评审意见文字密集。两张渲染图没有可见差异。","cause":"列宽与r2A完全相同，供应商列的39px文字空间不足以容纳46px的单行内容。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"评审意见比r2A稍宽；报价和质保值完整，合并关系仍然清楚。","problems":"供应商名称仍然换行，交期值也被拆成两行，两个并列指标行的扫描节奏因此变差；评审意见仍有较多换行。","cause":"供应商列宽60px，文字空间仅39px；交期列从59px缩至52px，文字空间从38px减至31px，不足以容纳完整交期值。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"完整行标识","widths":[67,86,59,52,95],"change":"从r2A的评审意见列取出7px给供应商列，使供应商表头和名称有46px文字空间，可单行显示；保留报价、交期和质保的完整值。评审意见会更密集，但它跨两行，适合承担更多自然换行。"}]}
